sentences.text: The name Neusticosaurus means "swimming lizard" and is sometimes misspelled as Neuticosaurus.
Neusticosaurus was one of the smallest nothosaurs and likely fed on small fish.
The parent group of Neusticosaurus is the family Pachypleurosauridae.
Neusticosaurus is classified within the class Reptilia.
Neusticosaurus lived during the Middle Triassic period.
Fossils of Neusticosaurus have been found in Italy, Switzerland, and Germany.
